raw_response:
I will keep most of my land in the wheat-maize rotation, because that is the steadiest system for me, I know it well, and with well irrigation I can protect yield better. I am 63 and my household only has 2 people, so I will not spread myself too thin with too much labor-heavy cotton. I will still keep some cotton, because I have long experience with it and I do not want all my income tied to one rotation. On the wheat-maize land, I will use better seed, put fertilizer in at moderate-to-strong levels, and rely on a few key irrigations instead of too many passes. For cotton, I will keep a smaller area, use improved seed, give it enough potassium, and spray more times because cotton usually needs tighter pest control. I will use rotary tillage on most fields because it is faster and fits my labor better than full ploughing on all land.
